sections.text_helper: Section 26.6.3 "I2C Own address register 1 (I2C_OAR1)" in chapter 26 (Inter-integrated circuit (I2C) interface), RM0008 Rev 21, page 776.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x08
Reset value: 0x0000
Bit 15 ADDMODE Addressing mode (slave mode)
0: 7-bit slave address (10-bit address not acknowledged)
1: 10-bit slave address (7-bit address not acknowledged)
Bit 14 Should always be kept at 1 by software.
Bits 13:10 Reserved, must be kept at reset value
Bits 9:8 ADD[9:8]: Interface address
7-bit addressing mode: don’t care
10-bit addressing mode: bits9:8 of address
Bits 7:1 ADD[7:1]: Interface address
bits 7:1 of address
Bit 0 ADD0: Interface address
7-bit addressing mode: don’t care
10-bit addressing mode: bit 0 of address

fields.name: Res.
fields.description: Reserved, must be kept at reset value

fields.name: ADD[9:8]
fields.description: Interface address 7-bit addressing mode: don’t care 10-bit addressing mode: bits9:8 of address

fields.name: ADD0
fields.description: Interface address 7-bit addressing mode: don’t care 10-bit addressing mode: bit 0 of address
